title: Managed Database: included native retention days
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database included native retention days is specified by contracted tier. Included native backup retention; calendar days integer.

| Contracted tier | Included native retention days |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 7 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 7 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 7 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 7 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 7 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 7 |

## Tier comparison
For included native retention days, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 7.
